items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She said to me later, said, “Do you remember anything I sang that night?”

ctx.x: Jimmy, and it was really a fabulous moment, Barbra Streisand introducing Jimmy Cobb. She was very sweet with him at the Waldorf. Anyway, she’s a fabulous vocalist.
She said to me later, said, “Do you remember anything I sang that night?” I said, “I surely don’t. If you don’t, I don’t.”

Yeah, it was really an interesting moment though, because – then I get a call from somebody – I wish I remembered his name – a journalist, saying, “Miles said it was Herbie Hancock and” – who was in that band? Herbie and whoever. Who was in the band?
